profile.name: Opentrons GEN-1/GEN-2 PCR热循环仪
profile.description: 一款用于PCR扩增的实验室热循环仪，配有可精确控温的样品块和加热上盖，可对PCR板中的样品执行变性、退火和延伸等温度循环步骤，适用于自动化分子生物学实验流程。
profile.description_en: A laboratory thermocycler for PCR amplification, featuring a precisely controlled sample block and a heated lid. It performs denaturation, annealing, and extension temperature cycles on PCR plates and is suited for automated molecular biology workflows.
